title.en: Grid 1: persona, reasoning, focus, examples, reply format, decision frequency
title.zh: 网格 1：角色、先写理由、侧重、示例、回复格式、决策频率

about.en: The package's own prompt (agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT): 3 headlines per stock, a decision every 5 trading days, the reply held to a strict JSON schema.
about.zh: 包里自带的 prompt（agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT）：每只股票 3 条新闻，每 5 个交易日决策一次，回复受严格 JSON schema 约束。

about.en: A persona in front: a portfolio manager at a long-only equity fund.
about.zh: 开头加角色：长线股票基金的基金经理。

about.en: A persona in front: a quantitative researcher at a systematic hedge fund.
about.zh: 开头加角色：系统化对冲基金的量化研究员。

about.en: A persona in front: the risk manager of an investment firm.
about.zh: 开头加角色：投资公司的风控经理。

about.en: A short reasoning field (3 to 5 sentences) before the orders.
about.zh: 先写 3 到 5 句简短推理，再下单。

about.en: Weigh the news most: headlines, confirmation, recency, red flags.
about.zh: 以新闻为主：标题内容、是否有多家确认、多新、红旗。

about.en: Weigh prices and trends most: returns, moving averages, RSI, distance from the high.
about.zh: 以价格和趋势为主：涨跌幅、均线、RSI、离高点多远。

about.en: Three made-up examples of an observation and a reply (a buy, a sell on a red flag, a hold).
about.zh: 三个编造的示例：一次买入、一次因红旗卖出、一次持有。

about.en: Any JSON object is accepted (JSON mode); the schema is only described in the prompt.
about.zh: 只要求是 JSON 对象（JSON mode），schema 只写在 prompt 里，不强制。

about.en: Nothing enforced: no JSON mode and no schema; the reply format is only the prompt's own sentence.
about.zh: 完全不强制：不开 JSON mode、不给 schema，只靠 prompt 里那句格式说明。

about.en: A decision every trading day instead of every fifth.
about.zh: 每个交易日都决策，而不是每 5 天一次。

title.en: Grid 2: risk rules, cash floors, headlines per stock
title.zh: 网格 2：风控规则、现金下限、每只股票的新闻条数

about.en: The package's own prompt (agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT): 3 headlines per stock, a decision every 5 trading days, the reply held to a strict JSON schema.
about.zh: 包里自带的 prompt（agent.SYSTEM_PROMPT）：每只股票 3 条新闻，每 5 个交易日决策一次，回复受严格 JSON schema 约束。

about.en: Four risk rules: at most 25% per stock, at least 30% cash when the regime is UNCERTAIN or RISK_OFF, sell 8% below the purchase price, prefer stocks above their 200-day average.
about.zh: 四条风险规则：单只不超过 25%，UNCERTAIN 或 RISK_OFF 时至少留 30% 现金，跌破买入价 8% 卖出，优先买在 200 日均线之上的股票。

about.en: A decision rule: buy only when the trend and the news are both positive, sell when the trend breaks or confirmed bad news arrives, otherwise hold; the judgement goes in each reason.
about.zh: 一条决策规则：趋势和新闻都向好才买，趋势破位或有已确认的坏消息就卖，否则持有，判断写进每笔订单的 reason。

about.en: One of the four risk rules alone: the 25% cap per stock.
about.zh: 四条风险规则里只留一条：单只不超过 25%。

about.en: One of the four risk rules alone: 30% cash when the regime is UNCERTAIN or RISK_OFF.
about.zh: 四条风险规则里只留一条：UNCERTAIN 或 RISK_OFF 时至少留 30% 现金。

about.en: One of the four risk rules alone: the stop at 8% below the purchase price.
about.zh: 四条风险规则里只留一条：跌破买入价 8% 卖出。

about.en: One of the four risk rules alone: preferring stocks above their 200-day average.
about.zh: 四条风险规则里只留一条：优先买在 200 日均线之上的股票。

about.en: A fixed cash floor: at least 30% in cash at all times, nothing else.
about.zh: 固定的现金下限：任何时候至少留 30% 现金，其他不变。

about.en: A fixed cash floor: at least 50% in cash at all times, nothing else.
about.zh: 固定的现金下限：任何时候至少留 50% 现金，其他不变。

about.en: No headlines (the news score, confirmation counts and red flags stay).
about.zh: 不给新闻标题（新闻分数、确认数和红旗还在）。

about.en: Six headlines per stock instead of three.
about.zh: 每只股票 6 条新闻，而不是 3 条。

method.en: Each variant changes one factor of the baseline prompt. Paired differences (same model, period and seed), mean over periods, 95% bootstrap interval, exact sign-flip p-value, Holm correction across the variants; 'noise' means the difference cannot be told apart from running the same prompt again. The attribution splits a return difference into holding more or less stock (level, timing) and holding other stocks (selection), in sums of daily returns.
method.zh: 每个变体只改基线 prompt 的一个因素。配对差（同一模型、同一时段、同一种子），按时段平均，95% bootstrap 区间，精确符号翻转检验，按变体个数做 Holm 校正；「noise」表示这个差别和把同一个 prompt 再跑一遍分不开。归因把收益差拆成持股多少（水平、择时）和持哪些股票（选股），按每日收益相加计算。

notes.en: Both grids ran gpt-5.6-luna through an OpenAI-compatible gateway. Grid 2 ran seeds 0 and 1 only (seeds 2 and 3 were not run). The earlier pilot, three models with one seed, is described in the documentation.
notes.zh: 两组网格都是 gpt-5.6-luna，经一个 OpenAI 兼容网关调用。网格 2 只跑了种子 0 和 1（种子 2、3 没有跑）。之前三个模型、一个种子的 pilot 写在文档里。
